fullDescription: A modern ART-EXHIBITION POSTER (A3 portrait) — strictly near-black #141414 type on a cream #f2ede1 ground, where the ONLY color is a central band of SIX equal vertical GRADIENT columns (cobalt / spectrum / magenta / amber / olive / teal), each with a diagonal white sheen. A heavy geometric ARCHIVO BLACK wordmark centers the top; PUBLIC SANS 700 caps carry the corner metadata and a centered dot-separated artist-name list; a gradient-FILLED 'ART' wordmark (background-clip: text) sits bottom-left. Reusable for any gallery / museum exhibition, design or type show, or arts-festival poster wanting a heavy caps wordmark over vibrant color-as-content.

structured.summary: A single A3-PORTRAIT modern ART-EXHIBITION POSTER whose entire personality is built from three moves: a heavy geometric ARCHIVO BLACK wordmark, PUBLIC SANS 700 caps metadata, and one central band of SIX vibrant vertical GRADIENT columns as the ONLY color. The ground is cream #f2ede1 and every piece of type is strictly near-black #141414 (with the footer 'ART' wordmark filled by a gradient via background-clip). Poster padding ~74px vertical / ~63px horizontal. TOP zone: a caps metadata row (Public Sans 700, ~24px, letter-spacing 0.06em) — 'FREE ADMISSION / 14-22 NOVEMBER 2027' top-left and a right-aligned two-line tagline 'WHERE PIGMENT / BECOMES LANGUAGE.' top-right — then a huge centered Archivo Black wordmark 'CHROMATIC' (~164px, line-height 0.9, letter-spacing -0.02em). CENTER band (~402px tall, the HERO): exactly 6 equal vertical columns in a CSS grid, each a different vibrant radial/linear GRADIENT (cobalt #4aa3e0->#143f8f, full-spectrum linear #f6d24a->#ee8888->#c9a3e8->#e7f0f6, magenta #e0356a->#a4112f, amber #f2a13a->#d97b1f, olive #7cbf3f->#1f6a2f, teal #2fb9a6->#0e6f6a), each carrying ONE diagonal white sheen streak (~-38deg, low opacity, blurred). BOTTOM zone: a centered dot-separated artist-name list (Public Sans 700, ~29px, letter-spacing 0.12em, line-height 1.9) over a baseline row with a gradient-FILLED Archivo Black 'ART' wordmark (~116px, background-clip: text over #8a2be2->#e0356a->#f2a13a) bottom-left and a small right-aligned caps venue block bottom-right. High-contrast, gallery-modern; color IS the content, no photos.

style.description: Gallery-modern print poster: a strict near-black-on-cream typographic system where the ONLY chroma is a band of vibrant gradient columns standing in for the artwork. The register is the collision of a heavy geometric caps WORDMARK (Archivo Black) with a clean geometric SANS (Public Sans 700) for all labels and lists. Discipline is everything: cream #f2ede1 ground, #141414 type, and a saturated six-column gradient band as the single color event, echoed once in a gradient-filled footer wordmark. No photos, no UI chrome, no second decorative color.
style.prompt: Design a single A3-PORTRAIT modern ART-EXHIBITION POSTER as a generically-branded original. Ground cream #f2ede1; ALL type strictly near-black #141414 EXCEPT the footer 'ART' wordmark, which is filled with a gradient via background-clip: text. Make the ONLY color a central band of SIX equal vertical GRADIENT columns. Pair a heavy geometric caps wordmark font (Archivo Black; Anton/Futura-heavy fallback) for the exhibition name and the 'ART' mark with a clean geometric sans (Public Sans 700, all-caps, letter-spaced) for every label, the artist list, and the venue. Keep it high-contrast and gallery-modern with generous margins. Invent an original exhibition name, gallery, dates, and fictional artist names; no photos, no second color, no rounded UI.

layout_and_structure.description: A3-portrait poster in three horizontal zones on a cream ground, ~74px/~63px padding. TOP: a Public Sans 700 caps metadata row (admission+dates top-left, right-aligned tagline top-right) then a huge centered Archivo Black wordmark. CENTER (~402px, hero): 6 equal vertical gradient columns in a CSS grid, each with a diagonal white sheen streak. BOTTOM: a centered dot-separated artist-name list, then a baseline row with a gradient-filled 'ART' wordmark bottom-left and a caps venue block bottom-right. On a narrow viewport the wordmark scales down, columns stay equal, and the three zones keep their proportions.

prompts.part: Top zone: caps metadata + centered wordmark
prompts.partPt: Top zone: caps metadata + centered wordmark
prompts.prompt: Set a caps metadata row in Public Sans 700, ~24px, letter-spacing 0.06em, near-black #141414: bottom-left two lines ('FREE ADMISSION' / a date range), right-aligned two-line tagline top-right ('WHERE PIGMENT / BECOMES LANGUAGE.'). Below, center a HUGE Archivo Black wordmark ('CHROMATIC', ~164px, line-height 0.9, letter-spacing -0.02em) in near-black on the cream.

Fill a central ~402px-tall band edge to edge with a CSS grid of EXACTLY 6 equal-width vertical columns, each clipped with overflow hidden. Give each a DIFFERENT vibrant gradient: cobalt radial-gradient(circle at 30% 70%, #4aa3e0, #143f8f); full-spectrum linear-gradient(160deg, #f6d24a, #ee8888 40%, #c9a3e8 70%, #e7f0f6); magenta radial(circle at 50% 60%, #e0356a, #a4112f); amber radial(circle at 50% 65%, #f2a13a, #d97b1f); olive radial(circle at 50% 55%, #7cbf3f, #1f6a2f); teal radial(circle at 40% 60%, #2fb9a6, #0e6f6a). Add to each ONE diagonal white sheen streak via ::after (width 140%, height 6%, rotate -38deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.35), blur ~2px) for a glossy poured-glass feel. This band is the hero and the ONLY color.

prompts.part: Bottom zone: artist list, gradient wordmark, venue
prompts.partPt: Bottom zone: artist list, gradient wordmark, venue
prompts.prompt: Center a Public Sans 700 caps artist-name list on two lines, dot-separated fictional names (~29px, letter-spacing 0.12em, line-height 1.9). Then pin a baseline row to the bottom: bottom-LEFT a big Archivo Black 'ART' wordmark (~116px, line-height 0.8) FILLED with a gradient via background-clip: text over linear-gradient(90deg, #8a2be2, #e0356a 45%, #f2a13a); bottom-RIGHT a small right-aligned Public Sans 700 caps venue block (street line + gallery name, ~24px).

special_ui_components.description: The hero band and the only color in the poster: six equal vertical gradient columns standing in for the artwork.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a full-width horizontal band of EXACTLY 6 equal vertical columns in a CSS grid, each clipped. Fill each with one vibrant radial or linear gradient in a distinct hue family — cobalt, full spectrum, magenta/crimson, amber, olive/green, teal — and add a single diagonal white sheen streak (~-38deg, ~0.35 alpha, slight blur) per column for a glossy finish. Keep them richly saturated; this is the ONLY color in the piece.

special_ui_components.description: The centered exhibition name in a heavy geometric sans.
special_ui_components.prompt: Set the exhibition name as a HUGE centered Archivo Black wordmark (~164px, line-height 0.9, letter-spacing -0.02em), near-black on the cream ground. It is the typographic anchor above the color band; keep it a single word or short phrase so the geometric weight reads at poster scale. Anton or a Futura-heavy is an acceptable fallback.

special_ui_components.description: All non-wordmark type: geometric sans, all-caps, letter-spaced, near-black.
special_ui_components.prompt: Use Public Sans 700 for every label, the centered dot-separated artist-name list, and the venue block. Set them all-caps, letter-spaced (labels ~0.06em, artist list ~0.12em), near-black #141414. Right-align the top-right tagline and the bottom-right venue; center the artist list; left-align the admission/date lines. Pin them to the corners so the color band owns the center.

special_ui_components.description: A heavy geometric wordmark whose letterforms are knocked out and filled with a gradient echoing the color band.
special_ui_components.prompt: Set a big Archivo Black 'ART' wordmark (~116px) in the bottom-left, FILLED via background-clip: text over linear-gradient(90deg, #8a2be2, #e0356a 45%, #f2a13a) with color: transparent, so the type reads as knocked out of the artwork. It echoes the color band while everything else around it stays near-black on cream.
